item.title: ‘Dream come true’: Eva Olid delighted after being named Manchester United’s new head coach
item.summary: United impressed by her ability to develop players Spaniard signs two-year deal after guiding Hearts to glory Eva Olid has described being appointed as the Manchester United Women head coach as a dream come true, after signing a two-year contract until 2028 with the option of a further year. The Spanish coach will replace Marc Skinner, whose surprise departure was announced on Monday morning . Continue reading...
